The team is made up of a {{p|Chikorita}}, {{p|Charmander}}, and a boy who turned into a {{p|Squirtle}}. {{left clear}} ==History== Squirtle, a human that became a Pokémon, decided to join Team Go-Getters along with Charmander and Chikorita. At first, he had trouble using his {{m|Water Gun}} attack, which made him sad. The team got their first real mission to save a {{p|Pichu}} and his big brother, {{p|Pikachu}} from a very territorial {{p|Skarmory}}. After going through many trials, such as a cave full of {{m|Poison Powder}}-using {{p|Shroomish}} and [[Team Meanies]], the team saved the brothers and defeated Skarmory, with Squirtle finally mastering Water Gun. ==Moves used== ===Squirtle=== {{anmov/h|water||Team Go-Getters Squirtle {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bubble|1=Tackle|2=Water Gun}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bubble|1=Tackle|2=Water Gun}}}} {{anmov|water|Bubble|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!}} {{anmov|normal|Tackle|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!}} {{anmov|water|Water Gun|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!}} {{anmov/f|water}} ===Charmander=== {{anmov/h|fire||Team Go-Getters Charmander {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Metal Claw|1=Ember|2=Flamethrower}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Metal Claw|1=Ember|2=Flamethrower}}}} {{anmov|steel|Metal Claw|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!}} {{anmov|fire|Ember|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!}} {{anmov|fire|Flamethrower|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!}} {{anmov/f|fire}} ===Chikorita=== {{anmov/h|grass||Team Go-Getters Chikorita Razor Leaf.png|Using Razor Leaf}} {{anmov|grass|Razor Leaf|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!}} {{anmov/f|grass}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{MD Red color}}|bordercolor={{MD Blue color light}} |ja='''Squirtle''': 小林沙苗 ''[[Sanae Kobayashi]]''
